about: Planning a team trip. People talk about a landmark nobody can picture; a photo is the right answer, and a follow-up with no new thing stays quiet.

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.text: For the Lisbon offsite, someone suggested a day trip to Sintra to see the Pena Palace.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: I've never heard of it. What does it even look like?

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.text: Okay that looks amazing. Let's put it on the list.
